push.title: W 3-0 vs Jebem Ti Kruha | You: 7.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.4 for a forward. A little under, a little lesson, a lot of upside.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Jebem Ti Kruha's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. That's a performance people follow.
+ Misplaced passes 1, down from your usual 6. You can build a whole match on that.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. More of that, please and thank you.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (2 of 3, down from your usual 75%). Best practice: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. That's the whole secret.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Mind this: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 0.5 below average. You're better than this number, and we both know it.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Goals per shot on target: 33%. Mid-pack today, 60%+ tomorrow.

Practice this: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

PhogsToffees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

Hang in there; it's coming. - Coach Lasso
